test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

TEMPO : TPOME :: DOLPHIN : ?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

TEMPO : TPOME

 
• **TEMPO is arranged according to reverse alphabetical order from left to right**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c72ae5b213a2e5943c88c0d820f7f4a70d1e741fbd7913890d96289959a5d2d6.png] 

Similarly,

**DOLPHIN** : PONLIHD.

 
• DOLPHIN is arranged according to reverse alphabetical order from left to right

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59c578c91f6943be272d413d0482f64a483c8db2a06b9a7200f8bb114aaec509.png] 

Hence, 'DOLPHIN' is coded as "**PONLIHD**".
